project: Illustrative example: multi-tenant SaaS with AI-assisted search

tasks.title: Define minimal contracts for API, data, deployment and AI
produces: image, port, healthcheck, variables and infrastructure outputs
AI response schema and evaluation set
acceptance: Consumers reviewed versions 1.0.0 and the mocks pass the contract
Decisions and unknowns with implementation impact are recorded

tasks.title: Implement the first API slice using the contracts and local fixtures
acceptance: Contract tests pass
Cross-tenant access is denied
Healthcheck matches the deploy contract

tasks.title: Implement the main user flow using a mock generated from the contract
produces: handling of empty, loading and error states
acceptance: Main flow works with valid fixtures
Keyboard interaction and form validation verified

tasks.title: Prepare the infrastructure and the development environment plan
acceptance: Static validation and plan are reviewable
Privileges, network and secrets meet the contract
Does not require an application image that does not exist yet to validate the plan

tasks.title: Prepare a reusable pipeline with federated identity
acceptance: Minimal permissions declared
Jobs do not depend on static credentials
Deploy does not start without the planned artifact and environment

tasks.title: Implement optional AI search with evaluation and isolation
acceptance: Retrieval filters by tenant before returning context
Provider failure preserves the main function
Quality and abstention metrics are computed with a versioned dataset

tasks.title: Prepare isolation, security and acceptance evidence cases
acceptance: Each critical risk has a validation case and an expected result
Fixtures contain no secrets or real personal data

tasks.title: Integrate application, AI and platform in development
produces: Release candidate in an authorized environment
acceptance: Complete flow passes with the real implementation
Isolation between tenants validated
Infrastructure plan matches the reviewed commit
Deploy respects the authorization recorded in the project

tasks.title: Consolidate evidence, gaps and the readiness decision
acceptance: All critical criteria have evidence
Items not run appear as not verified
Do not claim a production release from a development test
